hints.title: Circular Friend Indexing
hints.text: Map friends to 0-indexed positions 0 to n - 1. Friend 1 starts at index 0.

hints.title: Pass Distance Progression
hints.text: In round i (1-indexed), the ball moves i * k positions clockwise: curr = (curr + i * k) % n.

hints.title: Halt on Revisit
hints.text: Maintain a visited set. Stop the simulation as soon as a friend receives the ball a second time.

hints.title: Circular Step Simulation Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def circularGameLosers(self, n: int, k: int) -> list[int]:
        visited = set()
        curr = 0
        i = 1
        while curr not in visited:
            visited.add(curr)
            curr = (curr + i * k) % n
            i += 1
        return [p + 1 for p in range(n) if p not in visited]
```

complexity.notes: Simulation completes within at most n turns.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models 0-indexed modular arithmetic cleanly and converts back to 1-indexed.
